$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

configVersion.description: Agent Black Box config format version.

sessionDir.description: Directory where session reports are written. Paths must remain inside the repository by default; a trusted local external path requires the CLI override. Network and UNC paths are never allowed.

exclude.description: Repository-relative paths or path segments ignored by watching and reporting.

riskPatterns.description: Repository-relative paths or path segments treated as review-sensitive.

maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum changed file size scanned for possible secret-like values.

analysisPolicies.description: Optional named staged CI policies, explicitly selected with --policy. Secret and coverage gates are independent of severity/category filters. Built-in policies cannot be replaced.

retention.description: Optional defaults for session retention previews. Archiving still requires an explicit interactive apply.
